title: Rating your order
summary: After your order is delivered you are asked to rate it from one to five stars and can add a comment.
steps: Open the feedback request you receive after your order is delivered.
Give your order a rating from one to five stars.
Add a comment if you want to.
sees: You receive one feedback request per delivered order, a few hours after delivery.
Your review is private; it is not shown on the website.
notes: How the request reaches the customer (email or in the app) is not decided yet.
The exact delay after delivery is not specified yet; the meeting only said "a few hours".
